newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI to issue $130 mln debt in March.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI to issue $130 mln debt in March.

text.p: International Container Terminal Services Inc said on Friday it will issue $130 million in U.S. dollar denominated convertible notes in New York and London in March this year.
In a filing with the Philipine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), ICTSI said it still has to firm up the yield on its 10-year convertible notes.
It said the notes maybe converted into common shares of ICTSI between June 1997 and March 2004.
Jardine Fleming International Inc has been tapped as underwriter of the issue.

ICTSI said proceeds of the issue will be used to finance the construction of a sixth berth at its container terminal in Manila, an inland container depot and a grains terminal. It also said it will draw funds from the issue for its container project in Karachi, Pakistan.
